purpose: Fresh-seed Phase 1 confirmatory evidence for the frozen AI reliability v1 model. Seeds were selected and recorded before any Phase 1 evaluation run.

freshness_check.method: git grep over the frozen baseline for each candidate integer as a whole word, excluding binary NPZ payloads
freshness_check.note: The strings were absent from tracked source, configs, docs and JSON artifacts at baseline. Binary datasets were excluded because they contain feature arrays, not seed lookup text.

protocol.variants: all base_variants() and mixed_variants() from backend.locus_x.ai_evaluation

previously_reported_seeds.label: previously reported; not unseen evidence
previously_reported_seeds.reason: Used in the existing final-evaluation artifacts before this pre-registration.
